tasks.label: test_numpy
args: export PATH="/opt/pbs/bin:$PATH" && source "$HOME/miniforge3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh" && conda activate isca_env && cd "$HOME/Isca" && command -v qsub && exec python -u -c 'import os, sys; import numpy as np; print("Python:", sys.executable); print("Directory:", os.getcwd()); print("GFDL_BASE:", os.environ.get("GFDL_BASE")); print("NumPy version:", np.__version__); print("NumPy test:", np.arange(5).sum())'

tasks.label: run_script
args: export PATH="/opt/pbs/bin:$PATH" && source "$HOME/miniforge3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh" && conda activate isca_env && cd "$HOME/Isca" && exec python -u run_script.py
